From: [opaque block]

To: Tara Fischbach < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>: Kenana Amin <[contact omitted]>
Cc: [opaque block] ; Jessica Morrison <[contact omitted]>; Anna
Karmandarian <[contact omitted]>; Rogers, Seth R (Amman) < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: RE: Introductions
Hi Tara,
Apologies for the delayed reply. Would you be available on Wednesday at 9:00 am (Amman local time) for a virtual
meeting on MS Teams? My colleagues from USAID and Economic section are also available to join.
Best,
[opaque block]
From: Tara Fischbach [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Sent: Monday, April 5, 2021 4:04 PM
To: Kenana Amin <[contact omitted]>
[opaque block]
Jessica Morrison <[contact omitted]>; Anna Karmandarian <[contact omitted]
Subject: Re: Introductions
Hello Kenana
Thank you so much for the connection, pleasure to meet you all.
Would love to discuss further the level of your engagement in Jordan and understand the work you are doing. We
are very keen to understand specifically about the regulation and legislation coming from Jordan that could impact
our sector, like the data privacy law being finalized at this moment.
Perhaps we can meet this week to discuss?
Thank you in advance
Kind regards,

-
Tara Fischbach
Public Policy Manager, Levant | Policy
